Name: Gifts From Jas - Cute Letters and Nature Gifts
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Receive a gift by mail at every friendship level with Jas
Befriend Jas and receive thoughtful (and slightly mysterious) gifts in the mail.
Her presents tend to be a bit more… calm and wholesome.
Expect simple items, the occasional useful surprise, and things that make you wonder if she’s wiser than everyone else in town.
